notes.general_comments:
350 candidates took this 30 question multiple-choice examination and the mean score was 19.1 which is a
higher result than the mean score last year of 17.3.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 13, 14, 15, 20, 21,
22, 23, 24 and 26. These questions were answered correctly by 75% or more of the candidates. They
covered different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
